page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.8xlarge is a storage-focused virtual server powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94489 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) storage. This large-capacity storage is bundled directly with the instance. For external connectivity, the server provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU accelerators.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.d1.8xlarge is its reliance on traditional HDD storage instead of solid-state drives (SSDs), which limits random input/output operations per second (IOPS) but offers high resource density for sequential read and write operations. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile is optimized for high-capacity data storage and processing where the cost per gigabyte of storage is a critical factor. This makes the instance suitable for large-scale data warehousing, MapReduce jobs, distributed file systems, and cold data storage workloads.
